issues.quote: revenue rising 55.9% to $81.5 billion from $53.8 billion
issues.problem: Going from $53.8B to $81.5B is about 51.4% growth, not 55.9%.

data.summary: Almost everything checks out, but the revenue growth rate is wrong. Going from $53.8B to $81.5B is about 51.4% growth, not 55.9%. These other figures match Tesla's reported results: gross profit ($20.9B vs $13.6B), 25.6% gross margin, operating income ($13.7B vs $6.5B), 16.8% operating margin, net income ($12.6B vs $5.5B, up about 127.5%), split-adjusted diluted EPS ($3.62 vs $1.63) and R&D ($3.1B vs $2.6B).
